text: Underdog is the US daily fantasy sports and prediction markets business of Underdog Sports Holdings, Inc., led by its co-founders Jeremy Levine (Chief Executive Officer) and Brandon Stakenborg (Chief Product Officer). On 30 July 2026, London-listed IG Group Holdings plc announced that it had agreed to acquire Underdog for total consideration of up to approximately $1.3 billion, with completion conditional on regulatory approvals in the United States and clearance under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act; IG said on 8 September 2026 the acquisition remained subject to regulatory approvals.
short: Underdog, led by co-founders Jeremy Levine and Brandon Stakenborg, agreed on 30 July 2026 to be acquired by London-listed IG Group; still subject to US regulatory approvals on 8 September 2026.
